name: My Neighbor is a Yandere!?
source:
Seijuro, a normal guy in his twenties, wakes up in a room he doesn't remember from a coma after a mysterious accident that happened seven years ago.
With almost no recollection of his memories and past, he meets his gorgeous neighbor Nanase, who apparently took care of him all this time. She looks like a good and kind girl at first sight, but it seems that she has taken some drastic and rather extreme measures during all this time.

It's up to you and your own decisions to believe her or not to recover Seijuro's memories and unveil the mystery that surrounds this girl and her actions.

[From [url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/download/my-neighbor-is-a-yandere/]Nutaku[/url]]
translation:
征十郎是一个二十多岁的普通人，七年前发生的一场神秘事故后，他从昏迷中醒来，在一个他不记得的房间里。
在几乎不记得自己的记忆和过去的情况下，他遇到了他漂亮的邻居七濑，她显然一直在照顾他。乍一看，她是一个善良善良的女孩，但似乎这段时间她采取了一些过激甚至有些极端的措施。

是否相信她以及你自己的决定取决于你和你自己的决定，以恢复征十郎的记忆并揭开围绕这个女孩和她的行为的谜团。

[来自[url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/download/my-neighbor-is-a-yandere/]Nutaku[/url]]
